create_running_stats: create a RunningStats instance with a given dimension to track running mean and standard deviation
update_running_stats: update the running statistics with new tensor data using the Update method
normalize_tensor: normalize a tensor using the computed running mean and standard deviation
denormalize_tensor: denormalize a tensor back to original scale using stored mean and standard deviation
update_and_normalize: update running statistics and normalize the input tensor in a single call
